sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday seeking to bounce back from consecutive defeats. Despite their recent dip in form, Sandbach remain second in the table and will be heavy favourites against a Nomads side anchored near the bottom with just one win all season. This is a crucial opportunity for Sandbach to arrest their slide and reassert their title credentials.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth's unbeaten run continues to dominate the title picture—they travel nowhere this weekend but remain the benchmark at the top. Stafford Town host Alsager Town in what should be a routine fixture given the gap in quality; Stafford sit fourth with aspirations of a title challenge, while Alsager prop up the league with just one win. New Mills face Market Drayton Town in a mid-table encounter where both sides will be keen to climb: New Mills are sixth with decent recent form, while Drayton sit 12th and have won just one of their last four. Bilston Town host Widnes Town in a clash between struggling sides; Bilston have won just one of their last two, while Widnes remain winless this season with an alarming goal difference of -16. Wednesfield Community face Allscott Heath in another lower-table battle, with both teams having endured difficult spells recently. Finally, Dawley Town host Brereton Social in a fixture between two sides on similar points; both will be desperate to build momentum and move away from the relegation concerns looming over the bottom half of the division.
